# P272: Story Verification in /live — Acceptance Tests

**Purpose:** Testable acceptance criteria for story selection and verification in /live sessions.
**Usage:** Ralph Loop iterates until ALL tests pass (score 100%).

---

## Test Scoring

Score = passed_tests / 18 (shown as X/18 or N%)
Total tests: 18
Pass threshold: 18/18 (100% — all tests must pass)

---

## Category 1: Story Picker (3 tests)

### UAT-1.1: Story picker visible for authenticated creator with stories
**Given:** Creator is authenticated and has at least one story
**When:** Both participants are in the live session (IdleScreen, no story selected)
**Then:**
- A search input with placeholder "Search your stories…" is visible below the action buttons
- No story list is shown until the user types
- Story card (`data-testid="live-story-card-expanded"`) is NOT visible yet

**Verify:** Playwright MCP — look for `getByPlaceholder('Search your stories…')`

---

### UAT-1.2: Story picker not shown when creator has no stories
**Given:** Creator is authenticated but has zero stories in their library
**When:** Both participants are in the live session (IdleScreen)
**Then:**
- No search input is visible
- Only the two action buttons appear (current behavior, no regression)
- No error message or "you have no stories" label inline

**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot — no search input visible

---

### UAT-1.3: Story search filters instantly and selects correctly
**Given:** Creator has stories; story picker search input is visible
**When:** Creator types a word that matches one story
**Then:**
- Results appear immediately as each character is typed (no lag)
- Each result shows the first ~80 characters of the story and a point count badge
- Creator taps a result — picker collapses immediately (no confirm step)
- Story card appears above the action buttons on the creator's screen

**Verify:** Playwright MCP — type into search, click result, verify `data-testid="live-story-card-expanded"` visible

---

## Category 2: Real-time Story Sync (3 tests)

### UAT-2.1: Story card appears on listener screen after creator selects
**Given:** Creator selects a story in the IdleScreen
**When:** ~1–2 seconds pass (app polling fallback)
**Then:**
- Listener's screen shows the story card (`data-testid="live-story-card-expanded"`)
- Story text is visible on both screens
- Action buttons are still visible on both screens (story card is above them, not replacing)

**Verify:** Two-browser Playwright MCP — creator selects, check listener screen for story card

---

### UAT-2.2: Story card shows same content on both screens
**Given:** Creator selected "The calibration story"
**When:** Both screens show the story card
**Then:**
- Listener sees the same story title and preview text as creator
- No "Share" or "Open" icons appear on either screen's story card

**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot comparison — both screens

---

### UAT-2.3: No story picker shown to listener
**Given:** Story is selected and visible on listener's screen
**When:** Listener views the IdleScreen
**Then:**
- Listener does NOT see the story search picker
- Listener sees the story card, the two action buttons, and "Speak freely" below the buttons
- No search input visible on listener's screen

**Verify:** Playwright MCP — verify no `input[placeholder="Search your stories…"]` on listener page

---

## Category 3: Speak Freely Pre-Round (3 tests)

### UAT-3.1: "Speak freely" button appears when story is selected pre-round
**Given:** Story is selected, no round has started (ratingPhase = idle)
**When:** Either participant views their screen
**Then:**
- "Speak freely" text button is visible below the two action buttons on BOTH screens
- No X button or remove button on the story card itself

**Verify:** Playwright MCP — check "Speak freely" button visible on both screens after story selection

---

### UAT-3.2: "Speak freely" clears story from both screens
**Given:** Story is selected pre-round; both see the story card and "Speak freely" button
**When:** Either participant clicks "Speak freely"
**Then:**
- Story card disappears from BOTH screens immediately (no confirmation dialog)
- Story picker search input reappears on creator's screen
- "Speak freely" button disappears (no story to clear)
- Action buttons remain (participants can start a round without a story)

**Verify:** Two-browser Playwright MCP — click "Speak freely", verify story card gone from both

---

### UAT-3.3: "Speak freely" does not appear during an active round
**Given:** A round has started (either participant clicked an action button)
**When:** Either participant views their screen during the rating phase
**Then:**
- The pre-round "Speak freely" text button is NOT visible below the action buttons
- The standard mid-round "Speak freely" exit (inside the round UI) is unchanged

**Verify:** Playwright MCP — start round, verify no pre-round "Speak freely" button

---

## Category 4: Story Visible Throughout Round (3 tests)

### UAT-4.1: Story card visible during rating phase (drawer open)
**Given:** Story is selected and a round is active (rating drawer open)
**When:** Either participant views their screen during the sealed-bid rating phase
**Then:**
- Story card is visible ABOVE the rating drawer (not covered/hidden)
- No dark overlay (DrawerOverlay is transparent or absent)
- The story card expand toggle still works (linked points are accessible during rating)

**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot — story card and rating drawer both visible simultaneously

---

### UAT-4.2: Story card visible after gap reveal
**Given:** Both participants submitted ratings; gap is revealed
**When:** Either participant views the gap reveal state
**Then:**
- Story card remains visible above the JourneyToUnderstanding card
- Story content is still readable (not collapsed automatically)
- Action buttons for next steps (explain-back, speak freely) are below the gap reveal

**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot — story card present in gap reveal state

---

### UAT-4.3: Story NOT carried forward to next round automatically
**Given:** Round completed (gap shown, continue clicked by both)
**When:** Both participants return to IdleScreen for the next round
**Then:**
- Story card is NOT visible (cleared after round completion)
- Story picker search input reappears for the creator
- Session history (SessionHistoryList) shows the completed round

**Verify:** Playwright MCP — after Continue on both screens, verify no story card in IdleScreen

---

## Category 5: Verification Write (3 tests)

### UAT-5.1: story_verifications record written at speaker_rating = 10
**Given:** Story is selected; round completes with speaker_rating = 10
**When:** Both participants submit ratings (speaker = 10, listener = any)
**Then:**
- A `story_verifications` row is created in the DB with `accuracy_achieved = true`
- `understood_count` on the story increments by 1 (check via profile or DB)
- `ears_count` on the listener's profile increments by 1

**Verify:** DB query via Supabase Admin + Playwright MCP screenshot of congratulations screen

---

### UAT-5.2: No story_verifications record written at speaker_rating = 9
**Given:** Story is selected; round completes with speaker_rating = 9
**When:** Both participants submit ratings (speaker = 9, listener = any)
**Then:**
- NO `story_verifications` row created with `accuracy_achieved = true`
- Gap reveal is shown (not congratulations screen)
- `understood_count` and `ears_count` do NOT change

**Verify:** DB query via Supabase Admin — no new verification row; Playwright MCP shows gap reveal

---

### UAT-5.3: Congratulations screen shown at speaker_rating = 10, gap reveal at 8–9
**Given:** Story is selected; rounds completed at different ratings
**When:** Speaker rates 10 in one round, then 8 or 9 in another
**Then:**
- Rating = 10 → congratulations screen (existing behavior, unchanged)
- Rating = 8 or 9 → gap reveal screen (not congratulations)
- Rating = 8/9 does NOT trigger story_verifications insert with `accuracy_achieved = true`

**Verify:** Playwright MCP — full round at 10 shows celebration; round at 8 shows gap numbers

---

## Category 6: Regression — Existing Behavior (3 tests)

### UAT-6.1: Session without story works as speak freely (no regression)
**Given:** Creator has no stories OR skips story selection
**When:** Either participant clicks an action button
**Then:**
- Round starts normally (rating drawer appears)
- No story card, no story-related UI
- Gap reveal works as before
- No console errors

**Verify:** Playwright MCP — full round without story, verify no story card at any phase

---

### UAT-6.2: Story selection no longer auto-starts a round
**Given:** Creator selects a story (P272 decouples selection from round start)
**When:** Creator selects a story from the picker
**Then:**
- Story card appears on both screens (new behavior)
- Rating drawer does NOT automatically open (old P128 behavior removed)
- Creator must click an action button to start a round

**Verify:** Playwright MCP — select story, verify rating drawer NOT visible, verify action buttons still present

---

### UAT-6.3: Point positions visible in expanded story card (P279 dependency)
**Given:** Story is selected with linked points; P279 is deployed (getPointsForProfileDisplay in live mode)
**When:** Either participant expands the story card (clicks expand toggle)
**Then:**
- Linked points appear with the 7-point PositionButtons
- The other participant's existing position is visible (not hidden)
- Tapping a position button updates the position immediately (optimistic update)
- No share/open icons in the points area

**Note:** This test requires P279 to be shipped first. If P279 is not deployed, positions will render empty.

**Verify:** Playwright MCP — expand story card with linked points on listener's screen, check position buttons visible
